title: Mr. Mukasa Opens His Shop
subtitle: Working Fathers of Soroti
author: Anthony Mwesigwa
description: Follow Mr. Mukasa as he runs his shop in Soroti town, serving customers from near and far.
keywords: shopkeeper, shop, business, Uganda, Soroti, family, work, father, selling, buying
dedication: For all the fathers who run businesses to serve their communities.
authorBio: Anthony Mwesigwa is a passionate storyteller from Kampala, Uganda, dedicated to creating engaging educational books for young African readers.
backCoverText: What happens in a shop? Join Mr. Mukasa as he opens his doors, greets customers, and serves his community. A story about kindness and good business.
